bng.text: Leandros, an Akroan soldier of the Alamon, patrols the Horns with his squad and asks Mnesos at night why the gods have abandoned them.
The squad finds nine beheaded Akroans in the pass, including Captain Eumalos, and Leandros prays to Athreos for the dead before a minotaur horde charges them behind fallen boulders.
Kyrillos and others fall as the squad kills the minotaur leader, and Leandros climbs out to warn Akros, running past fallen Alamon squads for a day and more.
He reaches Akros at night to find that the minotaurs have built a wall around it, and he falls to his knees, too late to prevent the siege.
